Home.title: Special Needs Parent Chatbot
Home.subtitle: Ask me anything about supporting your child!

meltdown.reply: I’m so sorry you’re dealing with a meltdown—it’s tough on everyone. Try creating a calm space with dim lights or a favorite comfort item. Deep breaths can help too, for both of you!
meltdown.resource: Here’s a great article on managing meltdowns: https://www.understood.org/articles/understanding-meltdowns

iep.reply: An IEP (Individualized Education Program) is a plan to support your child’s unique needs in school. You’ll meet with teachers and specialists to set goals and accommodations. It can feel overwhelming, but you’ve got this!

default.reply: I’m here to help! Could you tell me more about what’s on your mind? I can offer tips or point you to resources.
